# Pliego: full context for coding agents

> Last Updated: 2026-10-10
>
> Boundary checkpoint (2026-10-10): public repository. Operational detail (topology, secrets,
> runbooks, people) lives in MADFAM's private ops repository under the repo-boundary contract
> (docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md). Never copy it here.

## Product

Pliego (Spanish: a sheet folded in the middle, the printer's sheet that becomes a book's
signature) is the platform for **sheet hyperobjects**: origami, kirigami, papercut traditions,
pop-up and paper engineering, book structures, flexagons and whole interactive paper dioramas.

Three things make a sheet object here:

1. **The flat sheet** — outline, cuts, creases (mountain, valley, score, perforation), glue tabs.
   This is the source of truth.
2. **The fold program** — the ordered, timed folds that take the flat sheet to its 3-D states.
3. **The stock** — the actual paper (grammage, caliper, grain, stiffness, crease memory,
   springback), described by a stock card whose physics is derived in exactly one place.

The motion is the product: a page turn, a pop-up rising as the book opens, a papel picado banner
in the wind. So the physics engine is a first-class, verified package, not a preview.

Status (2026-10-10): incubating, first deploy live. The landing is at https://pliego.madfam.io/,
the studio at https://pliego-app.madfam.io/studio/ and the API at https://pliego-api.madfam.io/api/v1/
(one container serves all three). Production changes only when a build is dispatched; merges do
not auto-deploy. docs/HONEST_STATUS.md is authoritative.

## Hard rules

- **Determinism:** the kernel emits byte-stable sheet documents; the engine replays bit-exactly
  with a pinned time step.
- **No solid modeling:** no OCCT, CadQuery, build123d or trimesh anywhere in packages/ or apps/.
  Brads, eyelets, magnets and stands are Yantra4D objects referenced through `hardware_ref`.
- **No prices:** no price fields in manifests or stock cards; quotes come from Cotiza.
- **No direct machine dispatch:** cut/score/fold jobs go through Pravara MES.
- **AI:** only through the Selva gateway (`SELVA_BASE_URL`, `SELVA_API_TOKEN`); inert until
  configured, fail closed; no provider keys in this repository.
- **Heritage:** traditional models and papercut traditions cite sources and credit their
  communities (for example papel picado and San Salvador Huixcolotla, Puebla). Never copy a modern
  designer's crease pattern.
- **Read-proof lanes:** every check prints what it scanned; scanning zero is a failure.

## Contracts

- **Sheet document:** FOLD 1.2 plus `pliego:` keys (`docs/spec/v1/sheet-document.md`, schema in
  `packages/schemas/sheet-document.schema.json`).
- **Stock card:** `materials/<slug>/stock.json` (`docs/spec/v1/stock-card.md`); derived physics is
  written by `pliego.stock.derive()` and checked with `python -m pliego.stock --check materials`.
- **Service:** one container; gunicorn `apps.api.app:app` on 8000; `/health` liveness, `/ready`
  readiness; `/metrics` on 9090 (internal). Landing `/`, studio `/studio/`, engine modules
  `/engine/`, API `/api/v1/`, `/llms.txt`.
- **Hosts (ruled 2026-10-10):** `pliego.madfam.io` (landing),
  `pliego-app.madfam.io` (studio), `pliego-api.madfam.io` (API). Flat labels, one Service.
- **Auth:** Janua issuer `https://auth.madfam.io`, audience `pliego-api`, RS256 via JWKS. OAuth
  callback `https://pliego-app.madfam.io/auth/callback` (exact match).

## Commons

`madfam-org/sheet-hyperobjects` (public; objects CERN-OHL-W-2.0, ruled 2026-10-10) is mounted at `projects/` as one git submodule pinned by SHA. One `<slug>/` per object
(`main.py`, `project.json`, `docs/README.md`), strict kebab-case slugs, born quadrilingual
(en/es/fr/pt). Classes: techniques, bases, traditional models, tessellations and engineering
origami, kirigami, papercut traditions, paper engineering, book structures, flexagons and toys,
dioramas. Interfaces (`spine`/`gutter`, `glue_flap` ↔ `glue_zone`, `tab` ↔ `slot`, `hinge`,
`page_edge`, `pivot`, `track`) let objects compose, checked before anything is cut.

## Ecosystem (consume, never rebuild)

| Service | Role |
|---|---|
| Yantra4D | Solid hardware (brads, eyelets, magnets, stands) through `hardware_ref` |
| Fashion Cabinet | Textiles (book cloth, ribbon, thread) through `material_ref` |
| hyperobjects-spec | Validation of every commons object (`pliego-spec`) |
| Janua | Identity |
| Dhanam | Catalog, checkout, entitlements (later) |
| Tulana | Pricing evidence (later) |
| Karafiel | CFDI (later) |
| Selva | LLM gateway |
| Cotiza | Quotes for printed, laser-cut and die-cut runs |
| Pravara MES | Fabrication dispatch |
| ceq | Generative printed art for sheets |
| Angelia Courier | Messaging and email |
| Enclii | Deploy, domains, secrets, status |
| Plausible | Analytics (self-hosted) |

## Conventions

- Code, identifiers, commits and PRs in English; user-facing copy es/en/fr/pt.
- Source files stay under 600 lines; 800 fails CI.
- GitHub Actions pinned by SHA; GitHub-hosted runners only (`ubuntu-24.04`).
- Agents never merge their own PRs. Every agent commit carries its `Co-Authored-By` trailer.
